question.problem: Evaluate the double integral ${∬}_{R}\frac{{y}^{2}+1}{x}\,\text{d}A$ over the rectangle $R=[1,e]\times [0,3].$
question.worked_solution:
We apply the multiplicative property of double integrals and then evaluate each of the integrals separately:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{R}\frac{{y}^{2}+1}{x}\,\text{d}A & ={∬}_{R}(\frac{1}{x})({y}^{2}+1)\,\text{d}A \\  & =({\int }_{1}^{e}\frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}x)({\int }_{0}^{3}({y}^{2}+1)\,\text{d}y) \\  & =[\operatorname{ln}⁡x]_{1}^{e}\cdot [\frac{{y}^{3}}{3}+y]_{0}^{3} \\  & =(\operatorname{ln}⁡e-\operatorname{ln}⁡1)\cdot (\frac{{3}^{3}}{3}+3) \\  & =1\cdot 12 \\  & =12\end{aligned}
$$
